extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media outlets, and the general public seeking Census Bureau news and media resources
extracted.subtask_description: Landing page for the U.S. Census Bureau newsroom that lists recent press releases, media resources, embargo rules, and subscription options for media and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargoed releases access restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to the Census Bureau's news embargo site is limited to qualified individuals representing media outlets whose chief attention is news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embargoed releases are not publicly accessible; only media representatives meeting the qualification (representing media outlets focused on news) may gain access. No further scoring or procedural details provided on this page.
